primary_metric: mean accuracy across 9 conditions (clean; noise fractions 0.2,0.4,0.6 with Gaussian sigma fraction*16; dropout 0.05,0.15,0.30; joint (0.4,0.15),(0.6,0.30)), averaged within each seed
control: uniform Gaussian-noise and dropout augmentation; same split, deterministic corruption draws, two added views per original, scaler and SVC; C=5, RBF gamma=scale
candidate: class-conditional one-vs-rest pixel Fisher ratio; inverse normalized scores as porosity map; map-weighted Gaussian noise (per-image RMS normalized) and dropout Bernoulli probabilities (capped at 1); two augmented views per sample

hyperparameters_frozen.preprocessing: StandardScaler fit on original training rows only
hyperparameters_frozen.fisher: per-class one-vs-rest (mean difference squared)/(class variance + rest variance + 1e-6), inverse with 1e-3 stabilizer, normalized mean 1

pass_fail_rule: Pilot support only if mean paired candidate-minus-uniform delta > 0.01 and candidate wins at least 2 of 3 seeds; otherwise no_gain if mean delta <=0, inconclusive for positive but subthreshold/mixed evidence. Falsification is supported if complemented map is not worse than uniform.
validation_used_for_choice: No tuning; choices fixed from proposal and benchmark protocol before validation.
final_output_policy: One final-mode invocation; refuse overwrite unless --allow-rerun explicitly supplied.
